citations.read_text_summary: Section 2(b): product prices and availability may be shown only if (a) Amazon serves the link displaying them, or (b) the data is obtained via Creators API or PA API.
Section 3(t): customer reviews or star ratings may not be displayed unless the link is obtained through Creators API or PA API and the API requirements are met.
Section 3(w): no link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement may make it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
Section 3(s): no artificially generated clicks or impressions, including by robot or software program.
